children.name: Settings
children.docComment: Strongly-typed application settings sourced from .env / environment.

children.name: _resolve_db_path
children.docComment: Return the configured DB path as a :class:`Path` (not yet created).

children.name: Payment
children.docComment: A row from the ``payments`` table.

children.name: _to_iso
children.docComment: Normalize ``value`` to an ISO-8601 string in UTC.

children.name: Plan
children.docComment: A row from the ``plans`` table.

children.name: Promo
children.docComment: A row from the ``promos`` table.

children.name: Redemption
children.docComment: A row from the ``promo_redemptions`` table.

children.name: _utcnow_iso
children.docComment: Return current UTC time in ISO-8601 (seconds resolution).

children.name: _to_iso
children.docComment: Normalize ``value`` to an ISO-8601 string in UTC.

children.name: _utcnow_iso
children.docComment: Return current UTC time in ISO-8601 (seconds resolution).

children.name: Subscription
children.docComment: A row from the ``subscriptions`` table.

children.name: TrafficSnapshot
children.docComment: A row from the ``traffic_snapshots`` table.

children.name: User
children.docComment: A row from the ``users`` table.

children.name: register_routers
children.docComment:
Attach every handler router (and shared middlewares) to the dispatcher.

    Order:

    1. Outer middleware ``UserContextMiddleware`` on ``dp.update`` so every
       update — message / callback / inline / pre_checkout / … — has the
       domain user resolved before routing.
    2. Routers in handler-resolution order. ``start`` first so ``/start``
       wins regardless of state; ``admin_router`` second (covers ``/admin``
       + every admin callback, gated by ``AdminOnlyMiddleware``);
       ``user_router`` last so it catches every user-flow callback and
       message that did not match the admin gate.

children.name: _build_admin_router
children.docComment: Return a fully-wired admin router with the gate middleware attached.

children.name: _plural
children.docComment:
Russian plural ending for «пользовател-» (ю / ям) by count.

    1 пользователю; 2/5/… пользователям. We only need the dative endings
    used in the confirmation prompt.

children.name: _format_plan
children.signature: _format_plan(plan: Plan, inbound_remarks: dict[int, str] | None = None) -> str
children.docComment:
Return a human-readable plan card body (HTML).

    ``inbound_remarks`` maps ``inbound_id`` → display name (``remark`` from
    the panel, or ``""`` if the panel response was unavailable). The card
    appends a «Подключения» line built from this mapping plus the list of
    inbound ids attached to the plan. If an inbound id present on the plan
    is missing from ``inbound_remarks`` (admin deleted it on the panel) it
    is rendered as ``id=NN (удалён)``; if the mapping is ``None`` or empty
    the line is rendered with raw ``id=NN`` tokens (graceful degrade when
    the panel is unreachable).

children.name: _options_from_data
children.docComment:
Rebuild :class:`InboundOption` list from FSM data.

    The wizard stores option dicts under ``inbound_options`` so we can
    redraw the multi-select keyboard on toggles without re-hitting the
    panel. This helper reconstructs the typed list back from raw dicts.

children.name: _format_promo
children.docComment: Return a human-readable promo card body (HTML).

children.name: _promo_is_active
children.docComment: Return ``True`` iff a promo is currently usable (not deactivated).

children.name: _parse_expires_at
children.docComment:
Parse user input for ``expires_at``.

    Returns:
    * ``None`` if the user typed ``-`` / ``skip`` / ``нет`` (no expiry).
    * An ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (string, seconds resolution) on success.
    * ``False`` if the input is unparseable — callers re-ask.

children.name: _expires_days_to_iso
children.docComment:
Convert a preset «+N days» value to an ISO-8601 expires_at string.

    Mirrors :func:`_parse_expires_at`: the resulting date is anchored to
    ``23:59:59 UTC`` so the same comparison logic in
    :func:`_promo_is_active` and the repository works unchanged. ``0``
    means «бессрочно» → ``None``.

children.name: _period_meta
children.docComment: Return ``(label, lookback)`` for ``key`` (fallback to default).

children.name: _format_expiring
children.docComment:
Format the "expiring soon" sub-section.

    ``tg_ids`` is a precomputed ``{users.id: tg_id}`` map (populated in
    :func:`_build_text`) so we don't hit the DB once per row.

children.name: _safe
children.docComment:
Return ``value`` as a plain string for HTML rendering.

    Telegram HTML mode is forgiving inside ``<code>`` tags, but
    usernames and first-names may contain ``<``/``>``/``&``. We strip
    those characters to keep the message valid without pulling in a
    full HTML-escaper.

children.name: _sub_status_glyph
children.docComment: Return the emoji for the subscription's effective status.

children.name: _format_payment
children.docComment: Return a single-line summary of a payment.

children.name: _build_user_router
children.docComment:
Return a fully-wired user router with every sub-router included.

    Resolution order: menu first (so ``/menu`` and main-menu callbacks
    short-circuit before more specific buy / promo flows pick up an
    update), then ``my_subscription`` (owns ``UserCB(area='my')`` plus
    the ``SubCB(action='keys')`` re-delivery), buy (carries the heaviest
    set of FSM-bound handlers plus pre_checkout / successful_payment),
    promo, and finally help (a single callback).

children.name: _shift_expiry
children.docComment:
Return ``current_expires_at + plus_days`` in YYYY-MM-DD format.

    Used by :func:`_format_confirm` for the "Действует до DATE" line on
    the extend confirmation card. Falls back to the raw string when the
    timestamp cannot be parsed (defensive — should never happen for a
    well-formed DB row).

children.name: _plan_is_buyable
children.docComment: Return ``True`` if a plan exists and is currently active.

children.name: _promo_is_usable
children.docComment:
Return ``True`` if a promo is non-expired and has capacity left.

    Mirrors the cheap checks inside :func:`app.services.promos.validate`
    but without the "already redeemed by this user" check — used in
    :func:`on_pre_checkout` where we accept the promo if it was valid
    when chosen even if its global state changed slightly (the
    one-per-user guarantee is enforced at redemption time by
    :func:`app.db.repos.promos.try_redeem`).

children.name: _remark_for
children.docComment:
Return the user-facing remark of ``inbound_id`` from ``options``.

    Accepts either a list of :class:`InboundOption` (in-memory) or a
    list of plain dicts (after a round-trip through the FSM, where
    aiogram serialises dataclasses to dicts). Falls back to a
    placeholder when the inbound is not found in the supplied options.

children.name: _options_to_jsonable
children.docComment:
Serialise :class:`InboundOption` for FSM storage.

    aiogram's FSM storage round-trips data through JSON, so frozen
    dataclasses must be flattened to plain dicts before being stashed.

children.name: _jsonable_to_options
children.docComment: Inverse of :func:`_options_to_jsonable`.

children.name: _format_bytes
children.docComment:
Return ``value`` rendered as a human-readable string.

    Uses binary units (1024 step) with a single decimal once we leave the
    ``B`` bucket — matching the convention used by 3x-ui itself in its
    web UI (so a user comparing values won't see a mismatch).

    Examples
    --------
    >>> _format_bytes(0)
    '0 B'
    >>> _format_bytes(1024)
    '1.0 KB'
    >>> _format_bytes(5 * 1024 ** 3)
    '5.0 GB'

children.name: _parse_iso
children.docComment:
Parse an ISO-8601 string from the DB into a UTC-aware datetime.

    The repo serialises with ``sep=' '`` and seconds resolution, but we
    accept ``'T'`` too so ad-hoc rows from external tools still load.

children.name: _days_delta
children.docComment:
Return ``floor((expires_at - now).total_seconds() / 86400)``.

    Positive when the subscription is still valid, negative when it has
    already expired. We deliberately use ``//`` so "expires in 12 hours"
    rounds *down* to 0 (the user reads "истекает сегодня"), and
    "expired 6 hours ago" rounds *down* to ``-1`` (the user reads
    "истекла 1 день назад") — both are the friendlier framings.

children.name: _is_active
children.docComment: Return ``True`` iff ``status='active'`` AND ``expires_at`` is in the future.

children.name: _format_days_line
children.docComment: Return the «осталось / истекла» line for a subscription.

children.name: _format_status_line
children.docComment:
Return a translated status line.

    Combines the DB ``status`` with a "is currently valid" check so a row
    with ``status='active'`` whose ``expires_at`` is already in the past
    (the expire-job hasn't run yet — Phase 8) still reads as "истекла"
    to the user, instead of misleading "active".

children.name: _format_sub_card
children.signature: _format_sub_card(sub: Subscription, traffic: tuple[int | None, int | None, bool]) -> str
children.docComment:
Build the HTML card body for a single subscription.

    The card has four lines: status, expiry timestamp, days-delta, and a
    traffic line that either renders live counters or falls back to a
    "панель недоступна" notice. We deliberately separate "the subscription
    exists" from "we could reach the panel" so a panel outage never hides
    the parts the bot already knows.

children.name: _sort_subs
children.docComment:
Return ``subs`` sorted active-first.

    Order:

    * Active subscriptions (status ``active`` AND not yet expired) come
      first, sorted by ``expires_at`` DESC so the latest extension is
      at the top.
    * The remainder (``expired``, ``revoked``, or ``active`` rows whose
      ``expires_at`` is already in the past — the expire job hasn't run
      yet) follow, sorted by ``created_at`` DESC.

    Ties are broken by ``id`` DESC for determinism. The ordering is
    pinned by tests in
    :mod:`tests.test_handlers_user_my_subscription` so future
    sort-key tweaks need a matching test update.

children.name: _build_subs_keyboard
children.docComment:
Build the inline keyboard for the «Моя подписка» screen.

    Layout (top → bottom):

    1. ``🆕 Купить новую подписку`` (``BuyCB(action='new')``) — always
       rendered, even when every existing sub is expired. This is the
       canonical entry point into the buy flow with ``sub_id=0``.
    2. For each visible subscription — one row with
       ``🔑 Ключи #N`` (``SubCB(action='keys', sub_id=N)``) and, when
       the subscription is currently active, ``🛒 Продлить #N``
       (``BuyCB(action='extend', sub_id=N)``). For inactive subs the
       row contains only the keys button — ``cb_pick_action_extend``
       in :mod:`app.handlers.user.buy` rejects non-active rows.
    3. ``◀ В меню`` (``UserCB(area='menu')``) — back to the main menu.

    ``visible`` MUST already be capped to :data:`_MAX_VISIBLE_SUBS` by
    the caller — this helper does not enforce the cap so it can be
    reused for screens that paginate differently.

children.name: _btn
children.docComment:
Tiny helper: build an ``InlineKeyboardButton`` from a callback factory.

    ``InlineKeyboardBuilder.row(*buttons)`` expects already-constructed
    buttons, so we materialise them here instead of going through
    ``builder.button(...)`` (which appends to the implicit pending row).
    Centralising this keeps the keyboard composition in
    :func:`_build_subs_keyboard` compact and easy to audit.

children.name: _no_subscription_kb
children.docComment: Keyboard shown when the user has no subscription history at all.

children.name: _pluralize_subs
children.docComment:
Return the Russian plural form for «подписка» given ``n``.

    Russian uses three plural forms: 1 / 2-4 / 5-20. ``n`` is the
    *displayed* count (always positive in our caller), so the function
    only needs to cover the three nominal buckets — there is no zero
    branch.

children.name: _options_to_jsonable
children.docComment:
Serialise :class:`InboundOption` for FSM storage.

    aiogram's FSM storage round-trips data through JSON, so frozen
    dataclasses must be flattened to plain dicts before being stashed.
    Mirrors the helper in ``app.handlers.user.buy``.

children.name: _jsonable_to_options
children.docComment: Inverse of :func:`_options_to_jsonable`.

children.name: AdminCB
children.docComment:
Top-level admin navigation: open an area / go back / cancel.

    The ``broadcast`` area additionally uses ``action="send"`` to confirm
    the post fan-out from the confirmation screen (see
    :func:`broadcast_confirm_kb` and :mod:`app.handlers.admin.broadcast`).

children.name: PlanCB
children.docComment:
Plan CRUD callbacks.

    ``action``:
    * ``list``           — show plan list (no ``id``).
    * ``create``         — start :class:`PlanCreate` FSM (no ``id``).
    * ``card``           — open a plan card.
    * ``edit_menu``      — open the «choose field to edit» keyboard.
    * ``edit``           — start :class:`PlanEdit` FSM for a specific field
      (``field`` = ``title``/``days``/``price_stars``/``traffic_gb``/
      ``inbounds``).
    * ``deactivate``     — soft-disable the plan.
    * ``preset``         — preset button inside the create-plan wizard
      (``field`` = ``days``/``price``/``gb``; ``id`` carries the chosen
      integer value).
    * ``manual``         — «введу вручную» button inside the create-plan
      wizard (``field`` = ``days``/``price``/``gb``).
    * ``toggle_inbound`` — flip the selection of one inbound inside the
      multi-select screen (``id`` carries the ``inbound_id``).
    * ``inbounds_done``  — confirm the inbound multi-select and proceed
      (no ``id``; used both in the create wizard and in the edit flow).

children.name: UserCB
children.docComment:
Admin "Пользователи" callbacks.

    ``action``:
    * ``search``       — start :class:`AdminSearchUser` (no ``id``).
    * ``card``         — open the user card by ``users.id``.
    * ``revoke``       — revoke a subscription; ``id`` is the
      ``subscriptions.id``, ``user_id`` is the parent user (so the
      handler can re-render the card after the revoke).
    * ``toggle_admin`` — flip the ``is_admin`` flag; ``id`` is
      ``users.id``.

children.name: StatsCB
children.docComment:
Admin "Статистика" callbacks.

    ``action``:
    * ``open``    — render the stats screen with the default 30-day
      window.
    * ``period``  — switch the headline period. ``field`` carries the
      window key (``7d`` / ``30d`` / ``all``).
    * ``refresh`` — re-render with the currently selected period
      (carried in ``field`` for stateless edits).

children.name: PromoCB
children.docComment:
Promo CRUD callbacks.

    ``action``:
    * ``list``        — show promo list (no ``id``).
    * ``create``      — start :class:`PromoCreate` FSM (no ``id``).
    * ``card``        — open a promo card.
    * ``deactivate``  — soft-disable the promo (sets ``expires_at=now``).
    * ``redemptions`` — show redemption history for a promo.
    * ``type``        — chosen during FSM ``waiting_type`` (``field`` carries
      ``percent|flat_stars|free_days``).
    * ``preset``      — preset button inside the create-promo wizard
      (``field`` = ``value``/``max_uses``/``expires``; ``id`` carries the
      chosen integer; for ``expires`` it is the number of days from now,
      with ``0`` meaning «бессрочно»).
    * ``manual``      — «введу вручную» button inside the create-promo
      wizard (``field`` = ``value``/``max_uses``/``expires``).

children.name: admin_main_menu
children.docComment:
Top-level admin menu shown by ``/admin``.

    Five buttons (one per row for readability on mobile): Plans, Promos,
    Users, Stats, Broadcast.

children.name: broadcast_confirm_kb
children.docComment:
Confirmation keyboard for the broadcast wizard.

    «✅ Разослать» fires :class:`AdminCB` ``area=broadcast, action=send``
    (handled in :mod:`app.handlers.admin.broadcast` under the
    ``BroadcastCreate.confirming`` state); «✖ Отмена» reuses the canonical
    cancel callback so the shared :func:`cancel_fsm` handler clears state.

children.name: back_to_main_kb
children.docComment: Single «◀ В меню» button — used as a fallback footer keyboard.

children.name: cancel_kb
children.docComment: Single «✖ Отмена» button used during any FSM wizard.

children.name: plans_list_kb
children.docComment:
Plan list: one button per plan plus «Создать» and «В меню».

    Inactive plans get a leading ``🔒`` so admins still see them but
    recognise their state at a glance.

children.name: plan_card_kb
children.signature: plan_card_kb(plan_id: int, *, is_active: bool = True) -> InlineKeyboardMarkup
children.docComment: Plan card: Edit / Deactivate / Back. Hides Deactivate if already off.

children.name: plan_edit_fields_kb
children.docComment: Choose which plan field to edit (title / days / price / traffic_gb / inbounds).

children.name: _plan_preset_kb
children.signature: _plan_preset_kb(field: str, values: Sequence[int], labels: Sequence[str]) -> InlineKeyboardMarkup
children.docComment:
Build a preset keyboard for one of the create-plan wizard steps.

    Each preset button carries ``PlanCB(action="preset", field=<field>,
    id=<value>)``; the «✏ Ввести вручную» button switches back to text
    input via ``PlanCB(action="manual", field=<field>)``; finally a
    universal cancel button drops the wizard.

children.name: plan_days_presets_kb
children.docComment: Preset days for ``PlanCreate.waiting_days``: 7/14/30/90/180/365.

children.name: plan_price_presets_kb
children.docComment: Preset prices for ``PlanCreate.waiting_price``: 0/50/100/200/500/1000.

children.name: plan_gb_presets_kb
children.docComment:
Preset traffic limits for ``PlanCreate.waiting_traffic_gb``.

    ``0`` means «без лимита» (matches xui ``totalGB`` semantics); the
    rest are common per-client monthly quotas.

children.name: promos_list_kb
children.docComment: Promo list: one button per promo plus «Создать» and «В меню».

children.name: promo_type_kb
children.docComment: Three buttons used during ``PromoCreate.waiting_type``.

children.name: promo_value_presets_kb
children.docComment:
Preset values for ``PromoCreate.waiting_value``, parameterised by type.

    * ``percent``    — 5/10/15/25/50%
    * ``flat_stars`` — 25/50/100/250/500 ⭐
    * ``free_days``  — 1/3/7/14/30 дней

    Unknown types fall back to a manual-only keyboard (no presets) so the
    handler can still recover via the «Ввести вручную» button.

children.name: promo_max_uses_presets_kb
children.docComment:
Preset max_uses for ``PromoCreate.waiting_max_uses``.

    ``0`` means «без лимита» (matches DB semantics — see
    :class:`~app.db.repos.promos.Promo`).

children.name: promo_expires_presets_kb
children.docComment:
Preset expires_at for ``PromoCreate.waiting_expires_at``.

    The callback id carries the number of days from «сейчас»: ``0`` means
    «бессрочно» (``expires_at=None``), the rest are converted by the
    handler to an ISO-8601 string ``now + N days`` in the same format as
    :func:`_parse_expires_at`.

children.name: promo_card_kb
children.signature: promo_card_kb(promo_id: int, *, is_active: bool = True) -> InlineKeyboardMarkup
children.docComment: Promo card: Redemptions / Deactivate / Back.

children.name: stats_kb
children.docComment:
Stats screen footer: period switcher + refresh + back.

    Three period buttons (7д / 30д / Всё время). The currently-active
    one is prefixed with «· » so it reads as the selected option without
    needing a separate label layout. The Refresh button carries the
    current ``field`` so the handler can re-run the same window.

children.name: UserCB
children.docComment: Top-level user navigation: menu / help / my subscription / cancel.

children.name: BuyCB
children.docComment:
Buy-flow callbacks.

    ``action``:
    * ``open``         — entry point ("Купить") — show plan list or the
      "продлить vs новая" action screen when the user already has at
      least one active subscription.
    * ``extend``       — user picked "🔄 Продлить #N" from the action
      screen (or directly from a subscription card in
      :mod:`app.handlers.user.my_subscription`); ``sub_id`` identifies
      the subscription whose expiry will be pushed forward.
    * ``new``          — user picked "🆕 Новая подписка" — proceed with a
      regular new-subscription buy flow (``sub_id`` stays ``0``).
    * ``plan``         — a plan was picked (id in ``plan_id``).
    * ``apply_promo``  — user wants to type a promo code.
    * ``confirm``      — proceed to the Stars invoice; the chosen
      inbound is carried in ``inbound_id`` (``0`` when the plan has a
      single inbound and the wizard auto-skipped the select step).
      ``sub_id`` > 0 signals "extend the existing subscription #N"
      instead of provisioning a brand-new one.
    * ``cancel``       — abort the wizard and return to the main menu.

    ``sub_id``:
    * ``0`` (default) — create a new subscription.
    * ``>0``          — extend the subscription with this id. The
      inbound is then inherited from the existing sub and the allow-list
      check is skipped (an existing sub may live on an inbound that is
      no longer attached to any plan).

children.name: InboundCB
children.docComment:
Inbound selection step (shared by buy + free-days promo flows).

    ``action``:
    * ``pick`` — user picked a specific inbound (``inbound_id``).
      ``plan_id`` is non-zero for the buy flow and ``promo_id`` is
      non-zero for the standalone promo flow — handlers route on
      whichever is set.
    * ``back`` — return to the previous step (plan list for the buy
      flow, promo entry for the promo flow). ``inbound_id`` is unused.

children.name: SubCB
children.docComment:
Actions over an existing subscription card.

    ``action``:
    * ``keys`` — re-send vless + QR + subscription URL.
    * ``back`` — return to the user main menu.

children.name: PromoActCB
children.docComment:
Standalone promo activation (free-days flow).

    ``action``:
    * ``open``   — entry point ("Активировать промокод").
    * ``extend`` — user picked "🔄 Продлить #N" from the action screen
      shown when the free-days promo could attach to an existing
      subscription instead of provisioning a new one; ``sub_id``
      identifies the subscription whose expiry will be pushed forward.
    * ``new``    — user picked "🆕 Новая подписка" — proceed with the
      regular inbound-selection step (``sub_id`` stays ``0``).
    * ``cancel`` — abort and return to the main menu.

    ``inbound_id``:
    * ``0`` (default) — unused for the ``open`` / ``extend`` / ``new`` /
      ``cancel`` callbacks; reserved for future flows.

    ``sub_id``:
    * ``0`` (default) — create a new subscription (or n/a).
    * ``>0``          — extend the subscription with this id. The
      inbound is inherited from the existing sub and the allow-list
      check is skipped (an existing sub may live on an inbound that is
      no longer attached to any plan).

children.name: user_main_menu
children.docComment:
Top-level menu shown after ``/start`` and ``/menu``.

    When the user already has an active subscription the «Моя подписка»
    button is shown first; otherwise «Купить» takes the leading spot. Both
    buttons are always present so the layout stays predictable — the
    ``has_subscription`` flag only reorders them.

children.name: back_to_menu_kb
children.docComment: Single «◀ В меню» button — used as a fallback footer keyboard.

children.name: cancel_kb
children.docComment: Single «✖ Отмена» button — cancels any active FSM wizard.

children.name: plans_kb
children.docComment:
Plan list shown to the user when buying.

    Each row is a single plan button labelled ``<title> · <days>д · <price>⭐``.
    A trailing «◀ В меню» button lets the user back out of the wizard.

children.name: subscription_kb
children.docComment: Subscription card keyboard: re-send keys / back to menu.

children.name: InterceptHandler
children.docComment:
Forwards records from the stdlib ``logging`` module to loguru.

    Preserves the original level name when known, falls back to the numeric
    level otherwise. Also walks the frame stack so loguru reports the actual
    caller instead of this handler.

children.name: setup_logging
children.docComment:
Configure loguru and bridge stdlib logging into it.

    Parameters
    ----------
    level:
        Optional override for the log level. When omitted, uses
        :data:`app.config.settings.LOG_LEVEL`.

children.name: AdminOnlyMiddleware
children.docComment: Reject non-admin updates with a polite message and stop propagation.

children.name: _extract_tg_user
children.docComment:
Return the originating ``from_user`` for any update-bearing object.

    Falls through unknown update types (poll updates etc.) by returning
    ``None`` — the middleware will then pass control on without writing.

children.name: UserContextMiddleware
children.docComment:
Inject the resolved domain ``User`` into handler data.

    On every update:

    1. Find the originating Telegram user (if any).
    2. Open a connection via :func:`app.db.engine.get_conn`.
    3. Call :func:`app.db.repos.users.get_or_create` — idempotent; also
       reconciles ``is_admin`` with ``settings.ADMIN_IDS``.
    4. Place the resulting :class:`app.db.repos.users.User` into
       ``data['user']``.

    Errors at the DB layer are logged and swallowed: the update still
    propagates with ``data['user'] = None`` so handlers can degrade
    gracefully (typically by replying with a generic error message).

children.name: _parse_iso
children.docComment:
Парсит ISO-строку из БД в aware-datetime (UTC).

    Подписки в БД хранятся через `_to_iso` (см. `db/repos/subscriptions.py`)
    в формате ``YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`` без TZ-маркера, иногда — с ``+00:00``.
    Здесь мы нормализуем оба случая в aware UTC.

children.name: _days_left
children.docComment:
Сколько целых суток осталось до истечения (отрицательное = просрочено).

    Считаем по числу полных календарных суток разницы; используется только
    для маппинга на kind ('3d'/'1d'/'0d').

children.name: _kind_for_days_left
children.docComment:
Маппит «дней осталось» в kind напоминания.

    Возвращает ``None``, если подписке не пора слать ни одно из 3d/1d/0d
    напоминаний (например, осталось 5 дней — рано, или -2 — это уже работа
    expire-checker'а).

children.name: setup_scheduler
children.docComment:
Создаёт и наполняет :class:`AsyncIOScheduler` тремя job-ами.

    Не стартует scheduler — это ответственность вызывающей стороны
    (`scheduler.start()` в `app/main.py`), чтобы можно было настроить
    timezone / event-listeners перед запуском.

children.name: InvoicePrice
children.docComment:
Final price summary returned by :func:`calc_price`.

    * ``stars`` — what the user will pay (always ``>= _STARS_MIN``).
    * ``raw_discount`` — the raw :class:`DiscountResult` from
      :mod:`app.services.promos` (before the Stars-minimum floor).
    * ``extra_days`` — bonus days granted by a ``free_days`` promo (0
      otherwise). Kept here so the confirmation message can show it.

children.name: calc_price
children.signature: calc_price(plan: Plan, promo: Promo | None) -> InvoicePrice
children.docComment:
Return the final Stars price for ``plan`` after applying ``promo``.

    Delegates to :func:`app.services.promos.compute_discount` and then
    raises the price to ``_STARS_MIN`` if the discount would otherwise
    produce a 0-Stars invoice (Telegram requires at least 1).

children.name: parse_invoice_payload
children.signature: parse_invoice_payload(payload: str) -> tuple[int, int | None, int, int]
children.docComment:
Decode the JSON written by :func:`build_invoice_payload`.

    Returns ``(plan_id, promo_id_or_None, inbound_id, sub_id)``. Raises
    :class:`ValueError` on a malformed payload — the buy handler treats
    this as "answer pre_checkout with ok=False".

    Backwards compatibility:

    * The new payload uses short keys ``p`` / ``r`` / ``i`` / ``s``.
      Old payloads (pre-inbound-selection rollout) use the long keys
      ``plan_id`` / ``promo_id`` and have no ``i`` field; we still
      accept them and fall back to :attr:`settings.XUI_INBOUND_ID` with
      a WARNING log so operators see exactly how many in-flight invoices
      were affected by the deploy.
    * The ``s`` key (sub_id-to-extend) is optional. Payloads without it
      — both legacy and current "create new subscription" payloads —
      decode as ``sub_id=0``.

children.name: _invoice_title
children.docComment: Return a concise title for the Stars-invoice header.

children.name: BroadcastResult
children.docComment:
Outcome of a broadcast run.

    * ``total`` — number of recipients attempted.
    * ``sent`` — successfully delivered copies.
    * ``blocked`` — recipients who blocked the bot / are unreachable
      (:class:`TelegramForbiddenError`); expected attrition, not a fault.
    * ``failed`` — any other delivery error (logged individually).

    Invariant: ``sent + blocked + failed == total``.

children.name: InboundOption
children.docComment:
Projection of a 3x-ui inbound surfaced to handlers and keyboards.

    Only the fields the bot needs to render a choice button and persist
    the selection. ``enabled`` mirrors the panel's ``enable`` flag; we
    expose it for completeness even though :func:`list_user_inbounds`
    filters disabled inbounds out — admin tooling may want to inspect the
    flag downstream.

children.name: _is_fresh
children.docComment: Return True if the cache is populated and within the TTL.

children.name: clear_cache
children.docComment:
Drop the cached inbounds list.

    Exposed for tests and for admin actions that mutate panel-side
    inbound state and need the next render to reflect the change
    immediately rather than waiting up to ``_CACHE_TTL_SEC`` seconds.

children.name: PromoValidation
children.docComment:
Outcome of :func:`validate`.

    * ``is_valid=True``  — ``promo`` is set, ``error`` is ``None``.
    * ``is_valid=False`` — ``promo`` may still be set (e.g. user already
      redeemed the code) but the caller MUST refuse usage. ``error`` is a
      user-facing message in Russian, safe to send to the chat verbatim.

children.name: DiscountResult
children.docComment:
Outcome of :func:`compute_discount`.

    * ``final_price`` — price in Stars to charge after the discount. For
      ``free_days`` it stays equal to the plan's nominal price.
    * ``extra_days`` — additional days to grant on top of ``plan.days``.
      Always 0 except for ``free_days``.

children.name: _utcnow_iso
children.docComment:
Return current UTC time in ISO-8601 (seconds resolution).

    Mirrors the helper inside :mod:`app.db.repos.promos` so this module
    doesn't reach into private repo internals.

children.name: compute_discount
children.signature: compute_discount(plan: Plan, promo: Promo | None) -> DiscountResult
children.docComment:
Compute the post-discount price (Stars) and bonus days for a plan.

    Rules:

    * ``promo is None``           → ``final_price = plan.price_stars``,
      ``extra_days = 0``.
    * ``promo.type == 'percent'`` → ``final_price = ceil(plan.price_stars
      * (100 - promo.value) / 100)``. ``promo.value`` is a percentage
      (1..100). The result is rounded **up** so we never undercharge by
      a fractional Stars (Stars are integers).
    * ``promo.type == 'flat_stars'`` → ``final_price = max(0,
      plan.price_stars - promo.value)``.
    * ``promo.type == 'free_days'`` → ``final_price = plan.price_stars``,
      ``extra_days = promo.value``.

    The final price floor is left at 0 here; the invoice builder
    (:mod:`app.services.billing`) raises it to 1 because Telegram refuses
    Stars invoices below 1.

children.name: _utcnow
children.docComment: Return current UTC time, seconds resolution, tz-aware.

children.name: _iso
children.docComment: Normalize ``value`` to an ISO-8601 string in UTC (seconds resolution).

children.name: _expiry_ms
children.docComment:
Convert a UTC :class:`datetime` to milliseconds since epoch.

    3x-ui's client ``expiryTime`` is a UNIX timestamp in **milliseconds**
    (not seconds). 0 means "never".

children.name: _parse_iso
children.docComment:
Parse an ISO-8601 timestamp produced by the repo back into a datetime.

    Accepts both the ``" "``-separated form (default of
    :func:`datetime.isoformat` with ``sep=" "``) and the ``"T"``-separated
    form. Always returns a timezone-aware UTC datetime — naive strings
    (which SQLite's ``CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`` produces) are assumed UTC.

children.name: _bonus_days_from_promo
children.docComment: Return the extra days a promo grants (0 unless ``type='free_days'``).

children.name: _make_sub_id
children.docComment: Generate a fresh subscription id (delegates to xui.clients).

children.name: PlanCreate
children.docComment:
Wizard: create a new plan.

    Flow: ``waiting_title`` (text) → ``waiting_days`` (positive int) →
    ``waiting_price`` (non-negative int) → ``waiting_traffic_gb``
    (non-negative int; 0 = unlimited) → ``waiting_inbounds``
    (multi-select via callbacks; empty set = «все доступные») → DB write
    + clear.

children.name: PlanEdit
children.docComment:
Wizard: edit one field of an existing plan.

    Flow: ``waiting_field`` (callback chooses title/days/price_stars) →
    ``waiting_value`` (text). The chosen field name and target plan id are
    kept in FSM data under ``plan_id`` / ``field``.

children.name: AdminSearchUser
children.docComment:
Wizard: find a user by ``tg_id`` or ``@username``.

    Single state — the admin types a digit-only string (interpreted as
    Telegram id) or an ``@handle``/``handle`` (interpreted as username,
    case-insensitive). On hit the handler clears the state and renders
    a user card.

children.name: PromoCreate
children.docComment:
Wizard: create a new promo code.

    Flow: ``waiting_code`` (text, unique) → ``waiting_type`` (callback:
    percent / flat_stars / free_days) → ``waiting_value`` (int, range
    depends on type) → ``waiting_max_uses`` (int ≥ 0; 0 = unlimited) →
    ``waiting_expires_at`` (``"-"`` / ``"skip"`` for no expiry, otherwise
    ``YYYY-MM-DD``) → DB write + clear.

children.name: BroadcastCreate
children.docComment:
Wizard: broadcast a post to every registered user.

    Flow: ``waiting_post`` (the admin sends any message — text, photo,
    video, etc.; its ``chat_id`` + ``message_id`` are stashed in FSM data
    under ``post_chat_id`` / ``post_message_id``) → ``confirming``
    (callback confirms; the stored message is copied to every user via
    :func:`app.services.broadcast.broadcast_message`) → clear.

    The post is never re-parsed or re-rendered — it is delivered verbatim
    with :meth:`aiogram.Bot.copy_message`, so any message type the admin
    can send is supported.

children.name: BuyFlow
children.docComment:
Wizard: buy a subscription via Stars.

    Flow: ``choosing_action`` (optional — only shown when the user
    already has one or more active subscriptions, lets them pick
    "продлить #N" vs "🆕 Новая подписка") → ``choosing_plan`` (callback
    chooses a plan) → ``choosing_inbound`` (callback chooses an
    inbound/server from the plan's allow-list; skipped automatically
    when only one inbound is available **or** when the user is extending
    an existing subscription — the inbound is then inherited from the
    extended sub) → ``confirming`` (user reviews and either pays or
    applies a promo) → ``entering_promo`` (text input of a promo code) →
    back to ``confirming`` with the promo attached.

    The state is cleared once the invoice is sent — the rest of the flow
    (pre_checkout / successful_payment) lives in stateless Telegram updates
    whose payload carries ``plan_id`` / ``promo_id`` / ``inbound_id`` /
    ``sub_id`` (0 for "create new", >0 for "extend sub #N").

children.name: PromoActivate
children.docComment:
Wizard: activate a standalone promo (typically ``free_days``).

    Flow: ``waiting_code`` (text input) → ``choosing_action`` (optional —
    only shown for ``free_days`` codes when the user already has one or
    more active subscriptions, lets them pick «🔄 Продлить #N» vs
    «🆕 Новая подписка») → ``choosing_inbound`` (callback chooses an
    inbound/server for the free-days subscription; skipped automatically
    when only one inbound is available **or** when the user is extending
    an existing subscription — the inbound is then inherited from the
    extended sub) → state cleared once a subscription is provisioned
    (or the user cancels).

children.name: XuiError
children.docComment:
Raised when the panel returns ``success=false`` or an invalid envelope.

    The string form contains the panel-provided ``msg`` (or an HTTP/status hint)
    so the message is safe to surface to operators in logs.

children.name: XuiClient
children.docComment:
Async client for the 3x-ui panel REST API.

    Holds a single :class:`httpx.AsyncClient` and an authenticated session
    cookie. The class is safe to share across coroutines; concurrent calls
    that race into ``login()`` are serialised through an internal lock so
    only one re-login happens per cookie expiry.

children.name: make_client_uuid
children.docComment: Generate a fresh random UUID4 for a vless client id.

children.name: make_client_email
children.signature: make_client_email(tg_id: int, username: str | None = None) -> str
children.docComment:
Generate a unique-ish client label for the panel.

    3x-ui requires the ``email`` field to be unique across an inbound.
    We embed the Telegram id for traceability and append a short random
    suffix so re-subscribing a user (after a delete) does not collide
    with stale traffic snapshots.

    When ``username`` is provided, it is normalised (lowercased; chars
    outside ``[A-Za-z0-9_]`` collapsed to ``_``; trimmed; capped at 32)
    and prepended for human-readable identification in the panel. If
    the resulting normalised slug is empty, the function falls back to
    the legacy ``tg_<id>_<hex>`` shape.

children.name: _make_sub_id
children.docComment: Generate a random subscription id (16 hex chars).

children.name: _q
children.docComment: URL-encode a path/query segment (mirrors the panel's encodeURIComponent).

children.name: _coerce_tg_id
children.docComment: Best-effort coercion of ``tg_id`` to the numeric ``tgId`` the API wants.

children.name: _coerce_numeric_fields
children.docComment: Coerce known numeric / bool fields in-place so the panel accepts them.

children.name: _parse_inbound
children.docComment:
Decode JSON-string subfields of an inbound payload to nested dicts.

    Non-destructive: the input ``raw`` is shallow-copied so callers that
    cache the original (e.g. in tests) are not affected. Missing or empty
    fields are tolerated.

children.name: build_subscription_url
children.docComment:
Return the public subscription URL for a client's ``subId``.

    Joins ``settings.XUI_SUB_BASE_URL`` with ``sub_id`` while collapsing
    duplicate slashes (the base URL may or may not have a trailing slash;
    callers should not have to care).

children.name: _find_client
children.signature: _find_client(inbound: dict[str, Any], client_uuid: str) -> dict[str, Any]
children.docComment: Locate a client record inside ``inbound.settings.clients`` by uuid.

children.name: _stream_params
children.docComment:
Extract vless query params from ``streamSettings``.

    Only includes keys whose value is non-empty; xray clients ignore them
    anyway and the resulting URI looks cleaner.

children.name: build_vless_link
children.signature: build_vless_link(inbound: dict[str, Any], client_uuid: str, email: str) -> str
children.docComment:
Build a ``vless://`` URI from a parsed inbound + a client uuid.

    Parameters
    ----------
    inbound
        Inbound payload as returned by :func:`app.xui.inbounds.get_inbound`
        (with ``settings`` / ``streamSettings`` already decoded).
    client_uuid
        Client UUID — used as both the userinfo of the URI and the lookup
        key in ``settings.clients``.
    email
        Email/label of the client. Used for the URI fragment (``#email``)
        so that xray-core clients can display a readable name.

    The host is taken from :data:`app.config.settings.XUI_SERVER_HOST`
    (not from the panel) because the panel often binds to ``0.0.0.0``
    while the public DNS name lives elsewhere.

children.name: make_qr_png
children.docComment:
Render ``text`` as a QR code and return raw PNG bytes.

    The bytes are ready to feed directly to ``aiogram``'s ``send_photo``
    (or to write to disk). Uses :func:`qrcode.make` with library defaults
    (auto-fit version, error-correction L, 10px box size).

children.name: _short
children.docComment: Compact json.dumps for log lines, truncated to ``limit`` chars.

children.name: monkey_settings
children.docComment: Yield a callable that patches `app.config.settings` attributes.

children.name: tmp_db_path
children.docComment: Return a path to a temporary, file-backed SQLite database.

children.name: make_user
children.docComment: Factory: insert a user row and return the :class:`User` dataclass.

children.name: make_plan
children.docComment:
Factory: create a plan row, with at least one attached inbound.

    Mirrors the production behaviour where every active plan has at least
    one inbound (enforced by the migration backfill in
    :func:`app.db.engine._apply_migrations`). Pass ``inbound_ids=None`` to
    fall back to ``[settings.XUI_INBOUND_ID]``; pass an explicit list to
    attach a custom set (use ``[]`` to skip attachment entirely, which is
    only useful for negative-path tests).

children.name: make_promo
children.docComment: Factory: create a promo row.

children.name: make_subscription
children.docComment: Factory: create a subscription row.

children.name: mock_bot
children.docComment: Return an AsyncMock standing in for :class:`aiogram.Bot`.

children.name: mock_xui_client
children.docComment: Return an AsyncMock with the XuiClient surface used by the codebase.

children.name: _fresh_settings
children.docComment:
Build a fresh Settings() with given env vars (no global mutation).

    We do NOT reload :mod:`app.config` so that the shared singleton used by
    other tests is not perturbed. We construct a new :class:`Settings`
    object directly.

children.name: test_admin_ids_pre_parsed_list
children.docComment: The validator must pass through real lists untouched.

children.name: _stub_inbounds
children.docComment: Build an `InboundOption` list with the given ids.

children.name: test_format_plan_with_remarks
children.docComment: Card body includes the «Подключения» line with resolved remarks.

children.name: test_format_plan_with_missing_remark
children.docComment:
An inbound id present on the plan but missing from the panel response is
    rendered as ``id=NN (удалён)``.

children.name: test_format_plan_no_inbound_remarks_arg
children.docComment: No remarks arg → the «Подключения» line is omitted entirely.

children.name: test_format_plan_empty_remarks_dict
children.docComment: An empty remarks dict still renders the «не настроены» hint.

children.name: test_expires_days_to_iso_zero_is_none
children.docComment: ``_expires_days_to_iso(0)`` returns ``None`` (бессрочно).

children.name: test_expires_days_to_iso_positive_returns_iso
children.docComment: ``_expires_days_to_iso(N)`` returns ISO string anchored at 23:59:59 UTC.

children.name: _walk
children.docComment: Yield ``router`` and every router it (recursively) includes.

children.name: _all_buttons
children.docComment:
Return ``(button_text, callback_data)`` for every button on ``kb``.

    Skips URL / switch_inline buttons — only callback buttons can ever
    be ambiguously unrouted.

children.name: _sample_inbound_options
children.docComment: Two-inbound mix exercising both selected and deselected branches.

children.name: _all_admin_keyboards
children.docComment:
Every admin keyboard variant the bot can render, with the FSM state
    each one is shown under (or ``None`` for stateless screens).

    Each tuple is ``(pytest_id, keyboard, raw_state)``.

children.name: test_register_routers_attaches_to_dispatcher
children.docComment: register_routers must include the start router and admin/user trees.

children.name: _user
children.signature: _user(*, is_admin: bool, user_id: int = 1, tg_id: int = 1) -> User

children.name: _state
children.docComment: Build a mock FSMContext, optionally pre-seeded with state data.

children.name: _stub_inbounds
children.docComment: Build an `InboundOption` list with the given ids (remarks autogenerated).

children.name: _clear_inbounds_cache
children.docComment: Drop the inbounds service cache between tests to avoid leakage.

children.name: _make_sub_obj
children.docComment: Build an in-memory Subscription stand-in for _format_confirm tests.

children.name: test_format_confirm_renders_extending_card
children.docComment: extending_sub set → card uses '🔄 Продление подписки #N' header and shows new expiry.

children.name: test_format_confirm_renders_new_card
children.docComment: extending_sub=None → card uses '🆕 Новая подписка' header.

children.name: _kb_buttons
children.docComment: Return ``[[(text, callback_data), ...], ...]`` for one ``InlineKeyboardMarkup``.

children.name: _flat_buttons
children.docComment: Return a flat list of ``(text, callback_data)`` across all rows.

children.name: _walk
children.docComment: Yield ``router`` and every router it (recursively) includes.

children.name: _all_buttons
children.docComment:
Return ``(button_text, callback_data)`` for every callback button.

    URL / switch_inline buttons are skipped — they cannot be "unrouted",
    so they are out of scope for this test.

children.name: _sample_inbound_options
children.docComment: Two inbounds — enough to exercise every button on the select keyboard.

children.name: _all_user_keyboards
children.docComment:
Every user-facing keyboard variant the bot can render, paired with
    the FSM state each one is shown under (or ``None`` for stateless
    screens).

    Each tuple is ``(pytest_id, keyboard, raw_state)``.

children.name: test_intercept_handler_emit_unknown_level
children.docComment: An unknown level name falls back to numeric level.

children.name: _domain_user
children.signature: _domain_user(*, is_admin: bool, user_id: int = 1, tg_id: int = 1) -> User

children.name: test_extract_tg_user_fallback_for_direct_message
children.docComment: A test harness may pass a Message directly (no Update wrapper).

children.name: test_calc_price_percent_clamped_high
children.docComment: value>100 is clamped to 100.

children.name: test_calc_price_unknown_type_fallback
children.docComment: Promo with bogus type defaults to the plan price.

children.name: test_calc_price_min_one_zero_priced_plan
children.docComment: A free plan with no promo also yields 1 (Stars min).

children.name: test_parse_payload_zero_promo_id_becomes_none
children.docComment: An explicit ``r=0`` in the payload is normalised to None.

children.name: test_parse_payload_bad_inbound_id_type
children.docComment: An explicit inbound_id that is not coercible to int raises ValueError.

children.name: test_parse_payload_legacy_long_keys
children.docComment: Old payloads with ``plan_id``/``promo_id`` long keys still parse.

children.name: test_parse_payload_legacy_missing_inbound_falls_back
children.docComment: Any payload missing ``i`` falls back to settings.XUI_INBOUND_ID.

children.name: test_parse_payload_legacy_uses_patched_default
children.docComment: The fallback honours the *current* settings.XUI_INBOUND_ID value.

children.name: test_payload_byte_limit_guard
children.docComment: An impossibly large payload is rejected if it exceeds 128 bytes.

children.name: test_payload_fits_in_128_bytes_for_large_ids
children.docComment: Realistic large ids (10 digits each) still fit in the 128-byte budget.

children.name: test_billing_payload_roundtrip_with_sub_id
children.docComment: build → parse round-trips sub_id>0 and omits 's' when sub_id=0.

children.name: test_billing_payload_legacy_without_s_returns_zero
children.docComment: Hand-crafted legacy payloads with no 's' key parse as sub_id=0.

children.name: _reset_cache
children.docComment:
Drop the module-level cache before AND after each test.

    The cache is process-global so leaks between tests would otherwise
    produce flaky behaviour depending on test ordering.

children.name: _xui_dispatch
children.docComment:
``request_json`` side_effect: client for clients/get, None for mutations.

    The new panel's ``update_client`` does a read-merge-write, so any test
    that drives the extend / revoke path must let the ``clients/get/:email``
    lookup return a client object instead of ``None``.

children.name: _csrf_bootstrap
children.docComment:
Stub the CSRF bootstrap GET that ``login()`` now performs first.

    Every ``login()`` GETs the panel root to read the
    ``<meta name="csrf-token">`` token before posting credentials. Register
    a reusable, optional stub so individual login/relogin tests don't have
    to spell it out (``is_optional`` keeps tests that never log in — e.g.
    the singleton test — from failing the "all responses requested" check).

children.name: _request_json_for
children.docComment:
Build an AsyncMock side_effect for ``client.request_json``.

    Returns the wrapped ``current`` client for ``clients/get/...`` paths
    (mirroring the panel envelope ``{"client": {...}, "inboundIds": [...]}``)
    and ``None`` for the subsequent mutating call.

children.name: test_make_client_email_no_username_legacy_shape
children.docComment: Without a username the legacy ``tg_<id>_<hex>`` shape is preserved.

children.name: test_make_client_email_normalises_special_chars
children.docComment: Dots, dashes and spaces collapse into underscores.

children.name: test_make_client_email_truncates_long_username
children.docComment: The slug portion is capped at 32 chars.

children.name: test_make_client_email_all_special_falls_back
children.docComment:
A username made entirely of special chars normalises to empty
    after the trim, so the helper falls back to the legacy shape.

children.name: test_make_client_email_empty_username_falls_back
children.docComment: An empty-string username is treated the same as None.

children.name: test_make_qr_png_long_payload
children.docComment: A long payload still encodes successfully.

children.name: _inbound
children.docComment: Build a parsed inbound dict for tests.

children.name: test_build_vless_link_no_security
children.docComment: Plain TCP without security still produces a vless URI.

children.name: test_build_vless_link_no_stream_settings
children.docComment: An inbound missing streamSettings degrades gracefully.

children.name: test_build_vless_link_bad_stream_settings_type
children.docComment: If streamSettings is not a dict the helper falls back to defaults.
